## DOWNLOAD_LINK_TTL_MS variable

How long a download link delivers the file: 5 minutes from issue.

**Signature:**

```typescript
DOWNLOAD_LINK_TTL_MS: number
```

## Remarks

A download link is a bearer capability, so its lifetime is the shortest of all: enough to start the download it was issued for. Fetching again issues a fresh link.
